title: Hide Advanced raw state behind lazy-open debug dropdown
specification:
# PRD: Hide Advanced raw state behind lazy-open debug dropdown

Priority: medium

## Problem
The project control-plane currently renders raw debug payloads for state, dashboard, jobs, and repo status directly inside the `Advanced` tab. Managers want these internals hidden by default so the page stays cleaner and the raw payloads are not rendered unless explicitly requested.

## Goal
Make the raw queue-record, repo-snapshot, and rendered-dashboard debug view available only through an explicit dropdown/disclosure in `Advanced`, and defer rendering of the raw JSON until the user opens it.

## Requirements
- Replace the always-visible raw JSON blocks in the project `Advanced` tab with a collapsed dropdown or disclosure control.
- Keep the `Advanced` tab itself visible, but hide the raw debug content until the disclosure is opened by the user.
- Do not populate or render the raw JSON payloads while the disclosure is closed.
- When the disclosure is opened, render the current state JSON, dashboard JSON, jobs JSON, and repo status JSON.
- If the disclosure is closed again, preserve reasonable UX behavior without forcing unnecessary rerenders while hidden.
- Maintain existing non-debug Advanced content and existing tab navigation behavior.
- Keep manager-vs-project visibility rules unchanged; this request applies to the project control-plane Advanced view.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Opening a project page shows the `Advanced` tab without immediately showing the raw JSON sections.
- Inside `Advanced`, the raw debug area is collapsed by default behind a visible dropdown/disclosure control.
- Before the disclosure is opened, the raw JSON content is not rendered/populated.
- Opening the disclosure renders the current raw payloads for state, dashboard, jobs, and repo status.
- Refreshing state while the disclosure remains closed does not eagerly repopulate the hidden raw payloads.
- Existing project-page navigation and non-debug Advanced content continue to work.

## Verification
- Add or update focused control-plane UI tests for collapsed-by-default Advanced debug content and open-to-render behavior.
- Add smoke coverage for the project page confirming the Advanced tab still exists while raw debug content is hidden by default.
- Run `npm run typecheck`.
- Run the relevant control-plane tests, especially `tests/smoke/control-plane.test.ts` and focused unit coverage for client-side Advanced rendering behavior.
